name: GuruGuruGaō
source: Welcome to Taiki Institute, a unique educational facility that accepts students of all species. As a new maintenance technician, you're just settling into your role when an unexpected event turns your world upside down. Uncover the mystery by piecing together clues from a diverse cast of characters.
